title: Add CSV export to reports
body:
## Problem
People copy tables by hand.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The Reports page shows an "Export CSV" button
- [ ] Clicking it downloads `report-<date>.csv` with one row per table row
- [ ] An empty report downloads a file with only the header row

## Notes
none
